mapper.sql: id, project_id, source_requirement, source_object_type, source_object_id, current_revision_no, acc_sync_status, acc_last_published_at, acc_next_retry_at, acc_retry_count, acc_last_event_id, acc_accepted_record_id, acc_archived_record_id, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted, tenant_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM imp_delivery_evidence WHERE FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE imp_delivery_evidence SET acc_sync_status = 'PUBLISHED_PENDING_ACC', acc_last_published_at = #{query.publishedAt}, acc_next_retry_at = NULL, acc_last_event_id = #{query.eventId}, version = version + 1, updater = CAST(#{query.actorUserId} AS CHAR), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.evidenceId} AND current_revision_no = #{query.expectedRevision} AND acc_sync_status = 'NOT_PUBLISHED' AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND deleted = b'0'

UPDATE imp_delivery_evidence SET acc_sync_status = 'ACCEPTED_PENDING_ARCHIVE', acc_next_retry_at = #{query.nextRetryAt}, acc_retry_count = #{query.retryCount}, acc_last_event_id = #{query.eventId}, acc_accepted_record_id = #{query.reviewRecordId}, acc_archived_record_id = NULL, version = version + 1, updater = '0', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.evidenceId} AND current_revision_no = #{query.currentRevision} AND acc_sync_status IN ('PUBLISHED_PENDING_ACC', 'ARCHIVE_PENDING_RETRY') AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND deleted = b'0'

UPDATE imp_delivery_evidence SET acc_sync_status = 'ARCHIVED', acc_next_retry_at = NULL, acc_last_event_id = #{query.eventId}, acc_archived_record_id = #{query.archiveRecordId}, version = version + 1, updater = '0', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.evidenceId} AND current_revision_no = #{query.currentRevision} AND acc_sync_status IN ('ACCEPTED_PENDING_ARCHIVE', 'ARCHIVE_ACK_PENDING_RETRY') AND acc_accepted_record_id IS NOT NULL AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND deleted = b'0'
